lines.text: City lights are humming, they know my name tonight
Driving with the windows down, I feel it ignite
Not the same old fire that burned me out before
This is electric, and it doesn't hurt anymore
Every signal's pointing straight to you
And I don't want to fight what's coming through
Dark static, buzzing in my chest
You're the frequency I can't get out my head
I don't need to understand, I just need to feel
Dark static, baby, make it real
We don't have to talk, the silence says it all
Your eyes do all the work, and I answer the call
This isn't just a moment, it's something taking shape
I'm ready for whatever comes when we escape

You're the frequency I can't get out my head
I don't need to understand, I just need to feel
